description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmployeeLanguageAPITest' for testing the 'EmployeeLanguageAPI' component within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes test cases for API methods such as getOne, getAll, create, update, delete, and their respective validation rules, focusing on employee language management functionalities.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class inheriting from EndpointTestCase, designed to test the EmployeeLanguageAPI class's functionality and validation rules related to employee language records within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test fixture data for employee language DAO from a YAML file into the test database.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeLanguageService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeLanguageService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific employee language record and handling cases where the record does not exist.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the API request validation rules for the 'getOne' method, including input validation and exception handling.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests fetching all language records for an employee, including pagination and metadata correctness.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the 'getAll' method, ensuring correct employee number validation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies creating a new employee language record, including validation of input data and error handling.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates input validation rules for creating a new employee language record.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee language record and verifies proper data modification and error handling.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the 'update' API method.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting specified employee language records and proper exception handling if records are not found.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the delete operation, including correct parameter input and error handling.
